nodes_reduced.why: the clusters that satisfy its requires have 2 node(s): sched-eks-cpu-efa-bigmem, sched-gke-bigmem

scaled_down.why: 2x2x2 replication: enough atoms to divide across ranks, which the unreplicated 304-atom cell is too small to do

Artifact:
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: metric-lammps-cpu-job-0043
spec:
  size: 2
  tasks: 0
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:jammy
      pullAlways: true
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/metric-lammps-cpu:libfabric-zen4
      launcher: true
      command: "flux-secretary run --nodes 2 --attempts 10 --model us.anthropic.claude-opus-5 -- lmp -in /opt/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/in.reaxff.hns -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -log none"
      commands:
        pre: |
          /mnt/flux/view/bin/python3.14 -m ensurepip
          /mnt/flux/view/bin/python3.14 -m pip install --no-cache-dir flux-secretary[all]
      volumes:
        secretary-token:
          path: /etc/flux-secretary
          secretName: flux-secretary-token
